diagnosis: The failing `grind` can expose the witness bisimulation relation, but it lacks the lemmas needed to promote successor pairs back to bisimilarity and to prove reflexivity for transitions from the unchanged right choice. Supplying `IsBisimulation.le_bisimilarity` and `HomBisimilarity.refl` repairs both simulation directions while retaining the compact proof.
proof_body:
by
  intro h
  use @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro s₁ s₂ hs μ
  cases hs with
  | choice h =>
    obtain ⟨R, hpq, hR⟩ := h
    constructor <;> intro s' ht <;> cases ht <;>
      grind [IsBisimulation, IsBisimulation.le_bisimilarity,
        HomBisimilarity.refl, ChoiceBisim]
  | bisim h =>
    grind [IsBisimulation, IsBisimulation.le_bisimilarity, ChoiceBisim]
